name: Fluid
product: Fluid 2, the site-specific browser builder by Todd Ditchendorf

evidence.says: The developer lists Fluid 2.1.2 as the latest version in its changelog.
Inspection of Fluid.app/Contents/MacOS/Fluid found a thin x86_64 Mach-O and the accompanying Info.plist confirmed version 2.1.2 and bundle ID com.fluidapp.Fluid2.
Homebrew lists version 2.1.2 as Intel-only and says it requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

name: Fritzing
product: Fritzing electronics design software by the Fritzing project

evidence.says: The project explicitly identifies the macOS release of Fritzing 1.0.8 as a universal binary that runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel.
The versioned release notes date Fritzing 1.0.8 to August 12, 2026.

name: Instagram unite
product: Instagram website bundle generated by BZG Unite for macOS

evidence.says: The submitted com.Instagram_unite bundle reports version 4.0.1, BZG Inc. copyright and Setapp build metadata.
BZG documents both the 4.0.1 version of Unite and its feature for generating apps from websites.

notes: A user-generated site wrapper is specific to this scan and has no separate release stream.

name: Creator Studio
product: Creator Studio website bundle generated by BZG Unite for macOS

evidence.says: The submitted com.Creator_Studio bundle reports version 4.0.1, BZG Inc. copyright and Setapp build metadata.
BZG documents both the 4.0.1 version of Unite and its feature for generating apps from websites.

limitation: The underlying website URL is absent from the scan metadata.
notes: A user-generated site wrapper is specific to this scan and has no separate release stream.

name: Intel Power Gadget
product: Intel Power Gadget for Mac by Intel Corporation
notes: The final Mac release was Intel-only.

evidence.says: Intel confirms product discontinuation and says it will not issue further updates.
The Intel developer identifies 3.7.0 as the latest macOS release in the official download thread.
The recorded Mach-O metadata for com.intel.PowerGadget 3.7.0 shows only 64-bit x86.

name: FoundryVTT
product: Foundry Virtual Tabletop by Foundry Gaming

evidence.says: Foundry documents a universal macOS desktop build with native Apple Silicon support for 14.356 and newer.
Foundry identifies 14.370 as Version 14 Stable 12 and dates it November 2, 2026.

notes: The official fresh Mac installer supplies the universal build.

name: Avogadro
product: Avogadro 1 molecular editor by the Avogadro project

evidence.says: The original scan's bundle metadata identifies Avogadro 1.2.0 with the submitted net.sourceforge ID and an x86 build.
The project archives the Avogadro 1.2.0 Mac DMG dated June 15, 2016.
The maintainers describe the original Avogadro 1.x as unsupported and Avogadro 2 as its successor.
The current Avogadro 2.1.0 successor ships separate Apple Silicon and Intel Mac installers.

limitation: No native build of the final Avogadro 1 release was found, and the historical scan covers the submitted copy.
notes: The Homebrew hint applies to Avogadro 2, which the project describes as a rewrite.

name: SogouWBInstaller
product: Sogou Wubi Input Method installer for Mac by Sogou

evidence.says: The scanned bundle identifies itself and its executable as SogouWBInstaller, uses an installer icon, and lists bundle version 1.0.
Sogou's official product page identifies the separate Mac Wubi input method and lists its installer download.

notes: The version refers to the submitted installer executable.

name: sixtyforce
product: sixtyforce Nintendo 64 emulator by Gerrit Goossen

evidence.says: The vendor offers sixtyforce 2.0.2 as the current download.
Homebrew identifies version 2.0.2 as an Intel Mac build that requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.
The developer confirms sixtyforce 2.0 runs under Rosetta on Apple Silicon and warns that performance is reduced.

notes: The developer's Apple Silicon rewrite updates describe work in progress.

name: Robin Morningwood Adventure
product: Robin Morningwood Adventure by Grizzly Gamer Studio

evidence.says: The developer lists separate Apple Silicon and Intel macOS builds of version 2.2.2, both dated November 11, 2026.

notes: Evidence covers the developer's itch.io distribution.

name: Vista
product: Vista 3 lighting and media control software by Chroma-Q

evidence.says: Chroma-Q lists Vista 3 R5 as the latest release and states Apple Silicon support uses Rosetta translation.

name: 32 Lives
product: 32 Lives plug-in adapter application by Sound Radix

evidence.says: Sound Radix marks 32 Lives discontinued, lists 2.0.6 as the latest release, and specifies an Intel-only application with no Apple Silicon support.
Sound Radix explains that 32 Lives requires 32-bit support available only on Intel Macs with macOS 10.14 or earlier.

name: Guitar Pro 7
product: Guitar Pro 7 tablature editor by Arobas Music

evidence.says: Arobas Music still archives the 7.6 Mac installer, but states support ended in May 2023 and licenses are no longer sold.
Arobas Music says Guitar Pro 7.6 requires Rosetta on Apple Silicon M1 Macs.

notes: Guitar Pro 8 superseded this major version.

name: AirconsoleOSX
product: AirconsoleOSX serial adapter utility by Cloudstore Limited (Get Console)
limitation: Launching AirconsoleOSX itself under Rosetta was not verified.
notes: Inspection of Airconsole.kext/Contents/MacOS/Airconsole in AirconsoleKEXT.pkg found x86_64 only, so the documented Airconsole LE serial workflow cannot use the bundled driver on Apple Silicon.

evidence.says: Get Console supplies AirconsoleDrivers-1.6.0.pkg and describes AirconsoleOSX as the Mac connection application for its serial adapter.
Reading AirconsoleOSX.app/Contents/MacOS/AirconsoleOSX in the official package showed x86_64 only, and Info.plist confirmed com.amixcapital.AirconsoleOSX 1.6.0.
Get Console says AirconsoleOSX 1.6.0 requires the companion kernel extension for Airconsole LE serial operation.
Apple says Rosetta cannot translate Intel kernel extensions.

name: FreezingCam
product: FreezingCam webcam utility by Kevin Picchi
limitation: Only the main executable architecture was verified.
notes: The current vendor build shows version 1.0 (build 2) and uses com.freezingcam.FreezingCam.

evidence.says: The maker's official page links the current FreezingCam download and identifies it as the same product launched in 2021.
Reading FreezingCam.app/Contents/MacOS/FreezingCam showed x86_64 and arm64 slices, and the app's Info.plist reported 1.0 build 2 with bundle ID com.freezingcam.FreezingCam.
The old com.qwertz.FreezingCam listing points to the same product website.

name: Billable
product: Billable – Time Tracker for Mac by Don Kooijman (Softwhere)
limitation: No architecture was published or verified for Mac App Store version 1.3.2.

evidence.says: Billable's official website describes its Mac time tracker and links directly to its Mac App Store listing.
Don Kooijman's Mac App Store release history lists 1.3.2 on August 18, 2021 and includes the scanned 1.2.1 release, with no architecture stated.

name: Mellow
product: Mellow transparent proxy client by mellow-io and eycorsican
notes: The final official Mac release was Intel-only and remains available as an archived download.

evidence.says: The maintainer's README says the Mellow proxy client is no longer maintained.
The GitHub release metadata dates 0.1.22 to August 14, 2020 and lists one macOS DMG.
Reading Mellow.app/Contents/MacOS/Mellow in the official DMG showed x86_64 only, and Info.plist confirmed org.mellow.mellow 0.1.22.

name: ClipMenu
product: ClipMenu clipboard manager by Naotaka Morimoto
limitation: No formal end-of-life announcement was found.
notes: The final known alpha was Intel-only; Clipy is a separate remake.

evidence.says: The developer identifies 1.0.0a1 as the test release from November 11, 2014; its linked DMG now returns HTTP 404.
The original site still advertises 0.4.3 and the old alpha, with no newer release listed.
The historical scan records only 64-bit x86 for the com.clipmenu.ClipMenu 1.0.0 alpha executable.

name: Crossy Road Castle
product: Crossy Road Castle for macOS by Hipster Whale
limitation: The official sources establish current Mac availability, but there is no independently verified executable architecture for 12.5.

evidence.says: Hipster Whale identifies macOS as a supported Apple Arcade platform for Crossy Road Castle without specifying the Mac executable architecture.
Apple's Mac software metadata matches com.hipsterwhale.crossycastle.macos and identifies 12.5 as released on November 18, 2026.

name: Hosting AU
product: Hosting AU microDAW by Ju-X

evidence.says: Ju-X links the public Hosting AU ZIP and lists 1.5.0 in its changelog.
A May 2026 user report describes opening and using Hosting AU with macOS displaying its Rosetta warning.

notes: Inspected Hosting AU.app/Contents/MacOS/Hosting AU in the official Hosting AU.zip and matched version 1.5.0 and the bundle ID; its Mach-O slices are x86_64 and i386.

name: NAS
product: Naverisk Mac Agent (NAS) by Naverisk

evidence.says: Naverisk identifies NAS as its background-only, automatically launched management agent and says the current agent supports M-series Macs.

limitation: The vendor describes M-series compatibility without identifying the executable architecture or a release version.
notes: The Naverisk.app bundle is an endpoint component of the Naverisk console and runs without a menu bar icon.

name: SnapNDrag Pro
product: SnapNDrag Pro Screenshot by Yellow Mug Software

evidence.says: Yellow Mug lists version 4.5.6 in the Mac App Store and records the addition of native Apple Silicon support in version 4.5.2.
Apple’s lookup identifies Mac App Store version 4.5.6 as com.yellowmug.SnapNDrag and dates it to August 26, 2026.
Inspection of SnapNDrag.app/Contents/MacOS/SnapNDrag found arm64 and x86_64 slices and its Info.plist confirmed version 4.5.6 and bundle ID com.yellowmug.SnapNDrag.

notes: The inspected vendor download and the App Store listing share the same version and bundle identifier.

name: YTD
product: YTD Video Downloader & Converter by GreenTree Applications

evidence.says: The official website lists version 7.8 as the latest macOS release.
Inspection of YTD.app/Contents/MacOS/YTD found arm64 and x86_64 slices and the bundled Info.plist confirmed version 7.8 and bundle ID com.greentreeapplications.ytd.

notes: The internal build number is 7.8.0.

name: HandShaker
product: HandShaker Android file manager by Smartisan

evidence.says: Homebrew records the 2.5.6 HandShaker cask as deprecated and disabled because the product is unmaintained.
Inspection of HandShaker.app/Contents/MacOS/HandShaker found a thin x86_64 Mach-O and its Info.plist confirmed version 2.5.6, build 408 and bundle ID com.smartisan.smartfindercommon.

limitation: Maintenance status comes from Homebrew because a Smartisan retirement announcement was unavailable.
notes: The last located vendor release remains available from the CDN and is Intel-only.

name: Get Lyrical
product: Get Lyrical iTunes lyric tagger by Shullian

evidence.says: The developer lists iTunes as a requirement for the app’s lyric-tagging workflow.
Inspection of Get Lyrical.app/Contents/MacOS/Get Lyrical found i386 and x86_64 slices and its Info.plist confirmed version 3.8.1 and bundle ID com.shullian.getlyrical.
Users of 3.8.1 report that its tagging fails with Apple Music on Catalina and that the lyric source has shut down.

limitation: Launching the Intel executable under Rosetta was not tested.
notes: The compatibility judgment concerns the lyric-tagging workflow.

name: Social Manager Tools
product: Social Manager Tools desktop GUI by Patryk Rzucidło (PTKDev)

evidence.says: The submitted bundle metadata identifies the app as Social Manager Tools 0.6.2 and specifies the PTKDev bundle ID.
Project documentation identifies PTKDev's Social Manager Tools GUI as a separate desktop download and links its historical official website and repository.

limitation: The historical download site failed certificate validation and the original GUI repository returned 404, leaving the final Mac release and its architecture unverified.
notes: The similarly named REUMTech repository carries a different bundle ID in its package metadata.

name: FutuNiuniu
product: FutuNiuniu classic (Futubull Legacy for Mac) by Futu

evidence.says: Futu's Mac release page links the legacy version 16.11.15608 and dates it April 9, 2026.
Futu's classic Mac download endpoint returns the version 16.11.15608 legacy installer.
The legacy cask identifies FutuNiuniu.app and the matching cn.futu.niuniu bundle ID and uses the version 16.11.15608 download.

limitation: The vendor and cask do not state the build architecture, and the official installer exceeds the brief's 150 MB inspection limit.
notes: The newer Futubull desktop cask uses the distinct cn.futu.niuniu.nx bundle ID.

name: Weiyun
product: Tencent Weiyun (腾讯微云), Tencent’s desktop cloud storage client

evidence.says: Tencent’s desktop download configuration provides separate macOS arm64 and x64 downloads for 6.0.9.82 and labels both November 26, 2026.
Inspection of 腾讯微云.app/Contents/MacOS/腾讯微云 found a thin arm64 Mach-O and its Info.plist confirmed version 6.0.9.82 and bundle ID com.tencent.mac.weiyun.

notes: The release date is Tencent’s published date and the official download was already live during the November 25 audit in America/Chicago.

name: Trojan-Qt5
product: Trojan-Qt5 graphical proxy client by TheWanderingCoel

evidence.says: The original project repository states that it was removed due to regulation and that the owner archived it on July 29, 2020.
The archived official repository has no remaining releases.
The archived scan records the exact TheWanderingCoel version 1.4.0 bundle with Intel code and no ARM slice.

limitation: The original release artifacts are unavailable, so 1.4.0 is the latest verified Mac build.
notes: The verified 1.4.0 build was Intel-only.

name: SPO2
product: SPO2 for macOS by Contec Medical Systems

evidence.says: The historical scan identifies Contec Medical Systems and records the com.contec.SPO2 Mac bundle with Intel architecture.
Contec directs users to retrieve device software using a product-package index code.

limitation: A current public Mac release, a device download code for this exact bundle, and Apple Silicon runtime evidence were unavailable.
notes: The scan's Info.plist identifies historical version 1.0, build 1.0.1.

name: Flowchart Designer 3
product: Flowchart Designer 3 for Mac by Guangjian Zhang

evidence.says: The Mac version history lists 1.2.10 and says version 1.2 added Apple Silicon support, without identifying a binary architecture.

limitation: The developer’s wording does not establish whether the current Mac build is arm64, universal, or Intel running under Rosetta.
notes: The developer says version 3 no longer receives new features and directs users to Flowchart Designer 5.

name: MetaTrader 4
product: MetaQuotes MetaTrader 4, historical CodeWeavers CrossOver OEM macOS bundle

evidence.says: The uploaded 4.0.0.1280 bundle identifies CodeWeavers CrossOver OEM packaging with Intel executables and the com.codeweavers.metatrader4 identifier.
MetaQuotes announced an updated Wine-based Mac package with build 1335 and linked to its replacement download.
MetaQuotes currently documents a Wine-based macOS installer and Apple Silicon compatibility using a net.metaquotes.wine.metatrader4 data directory.
The indicator developer describes Rosetta as part of installing and running the current MetaQuotes package on Apple Silicon.

limitation: The current package’s bundle ID and executable architecture could not be verified against the exact CodeWeavers OEM build in the listing.
notes: Current MetaQuotes documentation pertains to running the Windows trading terminal inside Wine.

name: Iqiyi Player
product: iQIYI desktop player for Mac (爱奇艺) by Beijing iQIYI Science & Technology
limitation: The current Mac App Store executable architecture could not be verified.

evidence.says: iQIYI lists 17.11.1 for its Mac desktop client without stating the Mac architecture.
Apple matches the Mac app to com.iqiyi.player and dates version 17.11.1 to November 23, 2026.

name: Plex
product: Plex, a Qt application with bundle ID sddda.Plex and unverified publisher
limitation: The publisher and product behind sddda.Plex could not be established.

evidence.says: The scanned Plex binary records the bundle ID sddda.Plex and a Qt/QMake-generated plist without a product version.
The name-matched cask supplies Plex, Inc.'s Plex Desktop package and does not link it to the sddda.Plex bundle.

name: Zhan Mokao
product: Xiaozhan TOEFL TPO Mock Exam for Mac (小站托福PC版) by Xiaozhan Education
limitation: The official Mac download requires sign-in, so the current downloadable version and its architecture could not be verified.

evidence.says: Xiaozhan Education still lists a downloadable Mac edition of its desktop TOEFL TPO mock-test application, with the public download entry dated September 8, 2018.
The vendor identifies the Mac desktop software as its Official 1–54 TOEFL mock-test application.
The historical scan identifies com.zhan.mokao as 小站托福PC版 and records only x86 for the scanned 2.2.3 build.

name: TrendMicroSecurity
product: Trend Micro Apex One (Mac) Security Agent main UI, now branded TrendAI
limitation: No current version of the exact MainUI executable was available for architecture inspection.

evidence.says: The vendor's TrendAI Security Agent for Mac deployment guide explicitly identifies the scanned com.trendmicro.tmsm.MainUI bundle.
The Patch 19 installation requirements include Apple silicon Macs and do not specify the MainUI executable architecture.
TrendAI continues publishing Mac Security Agent releases, including SEP-Mac build 3.5.8241.

name: Beaker Browser
product: Beaker Browser by Paul Frazee and the Beaker Browser project

evidence.says: Paul Frazee officially ended the Beaker Browser project and archived its repository on December 27, 2022.
The official repository marks Beaker 1.1.0 as its latest release and links its December 8, 2020 announcement.

notes: Inspected Beaker Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Beaker Browser in the official beaker-browser-1.1.0-mac.zip with file; the main executable is x86_64 only.

name: Corel Font Manager 2021
product: Corel Font Manager 2021 in CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 2021 for Mac by Corel
limitation: The later subscriber-only 2021.5 build was outside the binary inspection size limit.
notes: The architecture claim applies to the Apple M1 build of Update 1 for the 2021 edition.

evidence.says: Corel lists the June 15, 2021 Update 1 with separate Apple M1 and Intel downloads and a subsequent subscriber-only 2021.5 update.
Reading Corel Font Manager 2021.app/Contents/MacOS/FontManager in Corel's Apple M1 Update 1 package showed arm64, and Info.plist confirmed the exact bundle ID and version 23.1.0.389.

name: Corel PHOTO-PAINT 2021
product: Corel PHOTO-PAINT 2021 in CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 2021 for Mac by Corel
limitation: The later subscriber-only 2021.5 build was outside the binary inspection size limit.
notes: The architecture claim applies to the Apple M1 build of Update 1 for the 2021 edition.

evidence.says: Corel lists the June 15, 2021 Update 1 with separate Apple M1 and Intel downloads and a subsequent subscriber-only 2021.5 update.
Reading Corel PHOTO-PAINT 2021.app/Contents/MacOS/CorelPP in Corel's Apple M1 Update 1 package showed arm64, and Info.plist confirmed the exact bundle ID and version 23.1.0.389.

name: Bino
product: Bino 3D video player by Martin Lambers, with macOS binaries by Frédéric Devernay

evidence.says: The project says it has no prebuilt 2.x macOS release and links to Frédéric Devernay’s older Mac builds.
The Mac packager’s archive lists version 1.6.6 as its latest Mac binary and dates the uploads to January 23, 2018.
Inspection of Bino.app/Contents/MacOS/Bino found a thin x86_64 Mach-O and its Info.plist confirmed version 1.6.6 and bundle ID org.bino3d.
A first-person user report describes playing 3D video with the Intel Bino build on an M1 Mac and experiencing stutter.
Homebrew flags Mac version 1.6.6 as requiring Rosetta and records that its cask was disabled after a Gatekeeper check failure.

limitation: The M1 report does not give the exact version or macOS release.
notes: The app remains downloadable through the Mac package maintainer, and Homebrew’s disabled cask records a Gatekeeper issue.
